C1.explanation: Separate clean equipment addresses the board route; hand hygiene addresses the hand route. This puzzle does not predict infection probability.
Safe supplied water addresses the source route and hand hygiene addresses hands/cup contact. A clean container alone does not fix contaminated source water.
